verdict.rationale: The Sessions API explicitly supports creating and driving Droid sessions including managing their 'messages,' implying follow-up instructions can be sent to an active session without restarting, and the CLI's interactive mode (as opposed to droid exec's one-shot mode) implies ongoing conversational steering. However, there is no explicit walkthrough or example showing a user injecting a follow-up instruction mid-task to redirect an in-progress agent. Missing for 10: a concrete example/demo of steering an active session, hands-on or independent confirmation that follow-ups actually alter in-flight agent behavior rather than just being logged.
